correct.zh: 按文件名排序时，名称会从开头的字符起逐个字符进行比较。也就是说，开头部分相同的文件自然会相邻。既然希望相关资料紧挨着对应的业务报告书显示，那么相关资料的文件名就应当和业务报告书一样，以「报告_」+ yymm + w + 分隔符 + 作成者姓名 开头，再在其后加上表示这是相关资料的「_关联_」和流水号即可。此外，流水号还需要位数对齐。文件名的排列不是按数值比较，而是按字符串比较，因此若流水号只有 1 位 n，当资料达到 10 件以上时，「_关联_10」会排在「_关联_2」前面，无法按流水号的顺序排列。事先固定为 2 位 nn（01、02、…、10、11）并补零，字符串顺序就与编号顺序一致。开头部分与业务报告书相同、并且把流水号固定为 2 位的只有 エ，所以 エ 恰当。
correct.en: When files are sorted by name, the names are compared one character at a time starting from the first character. In other words, files whose beginnings are the same naturally end up next to each other. Since we want each related material to be displayed right beside its corresponding business report, the file name of the related material should begin with the same 「report_」+ yymm + w + separator + author name as the business report, and then have 「_related_」 plus a sequential number added after it to show that it is a related material. In addition, the sequential number must have a fixed number of digits. File names are ordered by string comparison, not by numeric value, so with a one-digit n, once there are 10 or more materials, 「_related_10」 comes before 「_related_2」 and they no longer line up in sequential-number order. If the number is fixed at two digits nn (01, 02, …, 10, 11) with zero padding in advance, the string order matches the numeric order. エ is the only option that has the same beginning as the business report and also fixes the sequential number at two digits, so エ is appropriate.

distractors.zh: 由于开头是「关联_」，按文件名排序时，以「关联_…」开头的文件会集中聚在一处，与以「报告_…」开头的业务报告书排在彼此远离的位置，无法满足与对应的业务报告书相邻显示这一要求。而且流水号只有 1 位 n，位数也没有对齐。
distractors.en: Because the name begins with 「related_」, sorting by file name groups all files starting with 「related_…」 together in one place, far away from the business reports that start with 「report_…」. This fails the requirement of displaying a related material next to its corresponding business report. On top of that, the sequential number is a single digit n, so the number of digits is not fixed either.

distractors.zh: 虽然流水号是 2 位 nn、位数已经对齐，但和 ア 一样，开头仍是「关联_」。排序后它们会聚集在与业务报告书那一组不同的位置，无法满足把相关资料与业务报告书并排显示这一关键要求。
distractors.en: Although the sequential number is two digits nn and the digit count is fixed, the name still begins with 「related_」 just as in ア. After sorting, these files gather in a place separate from the block of business reports, so the crucial requirement of displaying related materials alongside the business reports is not met.

distractors.zh: 开头部分与业务报告书相同，因此满足相邻显示的要求，但流水号是 1 位的 n，这一点不够充分。文件名是按字符串比较的，所以当相关资料达到 10 件以上时，「_关联_10」「_关联_11」会排在「_关联_2」前面，无法按流水号本来的顺序排列。固定了位数的 エ 才恰当。
distractors.en: The beginning of the name is the same as that of the business report, so the requirement of being displayed side by side is satisfied, but the sequential number being a single digit n is not enough. File names are compared as strings, so once there are 10 or more related materials, 「_related_10」 and 「_related_11」 come before 「_related_2」, and they do not line up in the intended sequential order. エ, which fixes the number of digits, is the appropriate answer.

points.zh: 按文件名排序是由从开头起逐个字符的字符串比较决定的。希望关联在一起、排在相邻位置的文件，原则上应让开头部分（前缀）保持一致，而把用于区分的信息放在末尾。
points.en: Sorting by file name is decided by string comparison, character by character from the beginning. As a rule, files you want to keep related and adjacent should share the same beginning (prefix), and the information that distinguishes them should be placed at the end.

points.zh: 在文件名中嵌入流水号或日期时，要像 01、02 那样固定位数并补零。位数可变时，字符串顺序会与数值大小不一致，10 会排在 2 的前面。
points.en: When embedding a sequential number or a date in a file name, fix the number of digits and pad with zeros, as in 01, 02. If the digit count varies, the string order disagrees with the numeric order and 10 ends up before 2.
